links.outcome: Overall accuracy of frontier LLMs on agentic hematologic oncology reasoning benchmark
links.effect: Across 32 frontier models, the best achieved only 68% overall accuracy despite high scores on medical knowledge assessments.
links.quote: Across 32 frontier models, the best achieved only 68% overall accuracy.

links.outcome: Reasoning trace quality versus accuracy in agentic reasoning
links.effect: Reasoning traces scored high on a rubric (91% above threshold) but decorrelated from accuracy, showing locally coherent rationales with globally incorrect conclusions.
links.quote: Reasoning traces scored high on a clinical reasoning rubric (91% above threshold) but decorrelated from accuracy, revealing a gap between locally coherent rationales and globally correct conclusions.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating agentic information-seeking (proactive data requesting) across sequential rounds before diagnosis
Assessing information utilization as a predictor of diagnostic accuracy
Detecting cognitive bias failure modes (anchoring, premature closure, search satisficing) in LLM clinical reasoning

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the agentic clinical reasoning and information-seeking performance of 32 frontier LLMs in an interactive oncology benchmark framework without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
